answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Accredited shipwright guild membership with boat builders certification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 454 pays 7264 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The prism sits in the mechanism itself, the pulse sits in the price of faking it, and the sable sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
